name: Spell Siphon
body:
Sometimes a certain set of skills are needed to deal with dangerous spellcasters. When in need, the spell siphon is the person to hire.

Class Features
Magical Hunter (Ex)

At 1st level, a spell siphon only gets the ability to use the magical disruption combat tactic, but they also may trigger it on an attack against a creature that casts spells or uses spell-like abilities. Additionally, when gaining advanced combat tactics, they may only choose magical disruption. This ability modifies combat tactics and advanced combat tactics.

Sense Aura (Sp)

At 2nd level, the spell siphon can use detect magic at will as a spell-like ability. At 10th level, this becomes the spell arcane sight. These spells use the spell siphons class level as their caster level. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 2nd level.

Disrupting Presence (Ex)

At 7th level, the spell siphon can make intonations and movements that distract a spellcaster’s spell components. The penalty to concentration checks from your advanced tactic applies to all enemies within 30 feet. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 7th level.

Steal Magic (Su)

At 7th level, the spell siphon can steal the magic from others and use it for themselves. Whenever they hit a spell-using target while their combat tactic is active, they may choose to siphon some magic from the target.

The target creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the spell siphon’s class level + their Intelligence modifier) or lose a prepared spell, spell slot, or daily use of a spell-like ability with a maximum spell level equal to 1/3 the spell siphon’s class level (maximum 6th). The spell siphon may choose the level of spell affected, if no spell of that level is available, the target levels a prepared spell, spell slot, or daily use of a spell-like ability at random of any other spell level. When this ability is used on a creature that spontaneously casts spells, that creature loses the ability to cast the stolen spell for 1 minute.

The spell siphon may cast the stolen spell or spell-like ability once within the next 8 hours. If the spell is not used within 8 hours, the energy dissipates and the spell is lost. When the spell is used, the caster level is the spell siphon’s class level and the spell uses the spell siphon’s Intelligence modifier for its DCs. The spell siphon may retain one stolen spell at 7th level, a second spell at 13th level, and a third at 19th level. You may not use this ability to cause targets to lose spells unless you have open slots for stolen spells. This ability replaces 2nd, 3rd and 4th combat tactics abilities.

Spell-Thwart (Su)

At 12th level, the spell siphon can shed magical effects placed upon them once per day. This operates as the spell break enchantment using the spell siphon’s class level as their caster level. At 16th level the spell siphon can use this ability an additional time per day. This ability replaces the slayer talents gained at 12th and 16th levels.
